claim.statement: Anysphere's current security and data-use pages say the Cursor app contacts Cursor backend domains for AI and product services, and that even bring-your-own-key AI requests pass through Cursor's backend for final prompt construction.

source.title: Cursor Data Use and Privacy Overview
source.locator: Other notes: bring-your-own-key requests traverse Cursor backend; AI request handling

limitations: The page describes service-level request routing and does not enumerate the exact destination sequence for one Agent request.
A user-supplied provider key does not establish a direct client-to-provider path under the publisher statement.
unknowns: The exact Cursor services, model providers, auxiliary models, regions and subprocessors used for a request are unknown.
Request payload construction, filtering, logging and retention for any particular session are unknown.
